explanation: On S₂, u=1 and v increases from 0 to 1. Thus x=1-v² and y=v, so x=1-y² is a left-opening parabola traversed from (1,0) to (0,1).

answers.correct_value: An arc of a left-opening parabola, traversed from $(1,0)$ to $(0,1).$
answers.wrong_value: An arc of a left-opening parabola, traversed from $(0,1)$ to $(1,0).$
